title: Beast Brigade
description:
Your beasts, your rules: Assemble your ultimate squad of Metabeasts and lead them into intense, fast-paced battles. Take direct control of your chosen beast, maneuvering across dynamic battlefields while unleashing your own arsenal of firearms to mow down enemy players and monstrous foes alike. Every beast boasts a distinctive set of devastating abilities and tactical skills, allowing for countless strategies and playstyles. With so many combinations to explore, the path to mastering them all offers endless hours of thrilling gameplay.

 Play Your Way, Anywhere:Choose your preferred platform and jump into the fight with seamless, hassle-free crossplay against players around the world. Busy schedule? Begin a match on your PC and pick up right where you left off on your mobile device—no interruptions, no compromises. Your progress, profile, and unlocked content carry over across all platforms, so no matter where you play, you’re always advancing your Beast Brigade legacy.

Unleash Full Customization:Tailor every detail to match your playstyle, from the weapons you carry to the way your beasts look and fight. Equip rare skins, armor sets, and visual effects to make your squad stand out on the battlefield. Fine-tune ability loadouts, tweak stats, and craft unique tactical builds to surprise opponents and dominate matches. Whether you favor raw power, speed, or cunning trickery, Beast Brigade lets you shape your team into the ultimate fighting force.
description_short: The new mob arena game, Beast Brigade, delivers an intense, action-packed experience - bringing monsters and modern combat together. Armed with an arsenal of advanced and powerful weaponry, explore a wide variety of creatures to assist you.
